#edu307update on the whole class novel project: We will start with "Handbook for Boys" and then "Bucking the Sarge" We will read each book for five weeks, with one overlappping week.

Each week a series of live chats will be offered. You must attend three live chats per book. The sessions times are:

Thursdays 6-9am in the chatroom, stop by for an hour or so for almost live chat.
Wednesdays 12-1pm f2f in Davis 119
Thursdays 9pm Video Chat (I will make link available may not make everyone)

As you read you will complete #edu307 blogposts. No parameters yet. Let us see how free write's go....but if I get a buncha chapter summaries...will switch it up...
